releases.body:
- **Antigravity:** the nine Estelle commands (`/estelle-login` and the rest) now live in `skills/`, the folder Antigravity reads, so they resolve.
- **Antigravity:** the MCP server shows as `estelle_tools`, not `estelle_Estelle`. If you signed in before, sign in again once: `/mcp` → estelle_tools → Authenticate.
- **Sign-in docs:** they now give only the path that was verified: `/mcp` → the Estelle server → Authenticate → paste the code.
- **Tests:** the runner tests build the runtime path portably on Windows.

Gemini CLI installs in one command: gemini extensions install https://github.com/Fate-Labs-CA/estelle-plugins (Estelle's tools, 26 skills, the /estelle:* commands and all four agents). Kimi Code installs from the repository root keep all four agents.

Licensed under the Fate Labs Plugin License: install and run these plugins, unchanged, to use Fate Labs' services (Estelle and Eden). Copies obtained earlier under Apache-2.0 keep those rights. Install docs now describe one sign-in (/estelle:login) on every host.

Fate Labs Estelle now runs in Gemini CLI and Google Antigravity (app and agy CLI), with memory on every prompt, session capture, all 26 skills, the slash commands and Estelle's agents. One browser sign-in (/estelle:login) now covers memory and capture on every host. Helper-agent tracking and Estelle's agents reach Cursor, Kimi, Qwen and Grok; OpenClaw gets a native plugin; fx gets the agents; mini-swe-agent redacts private text. Codex, Cursor and Grok keep working with an existing key.
Faster memory on every prompt: the hook now sends the prompt's memory recall before it does its capture work, so a busy turn no longer pushes recall past its deadline. No setting changes.
